data.name: Industry Unbound：无界工业
data.detailed_description:
Build an industry without borders

Industry Unbound is a single-player factory automation strategy game set on an infinite canvas. Begin with raw deposits and a fragile settlement, then design the mining, processing, power, and logistics networks that turn a planet into a self-sustaining industrial system.

Every building, route, cache, and power source belongs to the same living network. Place facilities, choose recipes, connect material-specific lines, manage throughput and congestion, and diagnose bottlenecks before shortages disrupt your plans. Power limits, construction supplies, storage, research, and human needs all shape the factory you build.

Plan, automate, expand

Build on an infinite canvas. Place mines, furnaces, assemblers, generators, storage, research facilities, and more where your network needs them.

Make logistics visible. Route individual materials, inspect line capacity and in-transit stock, and respond to blocked outputs or missing inputs.

Balance a real power grid. Match generation, storage, and demand as industrial expansion puts pressure on the network.

Research new capabilities. Produce and deliver physical research materials to unlock more buildings, recipes, and expansion options.

Keep settlements supplied. Reliable food, water, and industrial support let people survive, recover, and contribute to long-term growth.

Pursue planetary-scale projects. Coordinate construction and deliveries for major engineering milestones while your factory continues to run.

Start with guided scenarios that teach the core systems, then continue in an open-ended planetary mode where the next bottleneck, production route, and expansion plan are yours to solve.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti (4 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 560 (4 GB) or equivalent
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400F / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (6 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT (6 GB) or equivalent
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
